_comment: Ordered fallback chains for Claude subagent models. If a model pinned in agent metadata is unavailable at setup time (probed via the claude CLI, or matched against the known-unavailable list when probing is off), setup.sh remaps it to the first AVAILABLE model in its chain. Keyed by both the alias form (opus/sonnet/fable) and the full-id form, since agent metadata may use either. Order = most-capable-first within tier. Self-healing: when a suspended model is restored, the probe passes and no remap is applied. Build-time only — not copied into deployed projects.
